> any reason the arguments have different names?

No strong reason. I'm sure there used to be but in it's current form I think we could name these variables however we wanted to. `|source|` isn't super clear outside of the CSP violation context. `|codeString|` is a bit more explicit I guess. I'm happy to rename this to whatever we feel is best. HTML doesn't have to match ecmascript naming wise. There's already a mismatch wrt realm vs calleeRealm.
